rows.name: R. SOVEREIGN SHOALS
rows.description: Lt.-vessel in 12 fms., South, E.-ly, 2 miles from Royal Sovereign buoy. Shows 3 flashes in 23 secs., at intervals of 37 secs. Small ball over usual mast-head ball (In summer of 1887, light will be altered to triple-flashing ev. 45 secs.)

rows.name: Eastbourne
rows.description: A fixed green light on the new pier

rows.name: BEACHY HEAD
rows.description: White tower, 47 ft. high, on summit of Belle-tout Cliff. From the eastward the light will open when bearing N.W. by W., and by keeping it so will lead 1½ mile outside Royal Sovereign Shoals (In summer of 1887, light will be altered to show a flash of 4 secs. in every 15 secs.)

rows.name: Newhaven
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright lt. 2. One fixed Tide light
rows.description: 1. Wood framework, on outer extr. of E. pier 2. Lt.-ho., 55 ft. high, on outer extr. of West pier. Under 10 ft. on bar, lt. is green; 10 to 14 ft., red; over 14 ft., bright. Two small red lts. near end of break-water in progress. A small green lt. on each pier, 200 yds. within entr

rows.name: Brighton Chain Pier
rows.description: One fixed green light

rows.name: ,, Pile Pier
rows.description: One fixed red light

rows.name: Shoreham Harbour
rows.character: One fixed bright light, and Tide light Two fixed green lights
rows.description: Tide lt. on central pier, green while 8 to 11 ft., bright while 11 ft. and over, and red at high water; bears S. by W. ½ W., 250 yards from upper fix. br. lt. Two green lts., one on E., one on W. pier-head. Approaching, keep high bright lt. open E. of W. pier green lt.

rows.name: Worthing Pier
rows.description: A fixed bright light on the pier

rows.name: Littlehampton
rows.character: Fix. red lt. and Tide lts.
rows.description: White lt.-ho., 40 ft. high, on N. end of E. pier. Tide lts. on S. end of pier: bright 10 ft., green 11 ft., red 12 ft., red and bright 13 ft., two bright 14 ft., bright and green 15 ft., till high water. In line, North, lead to entrance

rows.name: Selsea Bill
rows.character: One fix. green or red lt.
rows.description: Light green between East and S. ½ E., thence red to S.W. by W. Fishing light

rows.name: OWERS LIGHTVESSEL
rows.description: Off S. end of Shoal, in 16 fms. A flash every ½ min., alternately br. & red. Red, with ball

rows.name: Nab Lightvessel
rows.description: In 5½ fathoms, near New Grounds; must be passed to eastward. Red, with balls

rows.name: ST. CATHERINE'S PT.
rows.description: Stone tower, 84 feet high. Light visible between E. ¾ S. and N.W. ½ W.

rows.name: Warner Lightvessel
rows.description: In 13 fathoms, on the eastern part of the shoal. Red, with ball

rows.name: Ryde Pier
rows.description: Also green light on West side, and red and green lights on East side of pier-head

rows.name: SPITHEAD
rows.description: Green light on fort at Brading Haven; bright light on No Man's Land Fort, with red sector of 14° over Ryde Sand Head and Sturbridge Shoal; red light on Horse Sand Fort; bright light on Spit Sand Fort

rows.name: Stokes Bay Pier
rows.description: Red lights on East and West ends. Two others shown when steamers expected

rows.name: Southsea Castle
rows.character: One fix. red or green lt.
rows.description: Shows red in channel betw. Spit Refuge Buoy and Horse Fort, or between S. ¾ W. and S.W. by S. ½ S.; thence green to West of the Spit Buoy to W. ½ S.

rows.name: Southsea
rows.description: Two red lights on Clarence Esplanade Pier. Also bright light when steamers plying

rows.name: Portsmouth Harbour
rows.character: One fixed red or green light
rows.description: On South end of South railway jetty. Shows red on East side of harbour to S.E. tangent of Block House Fort, and green westward of that line. Small lts. shown at landing-piers

rows.name: Calshot Lightvessel
rows.description: Off Calshot Castle, on East side of channel, in 3½ fathoms. Red, with ball

rows.name: Calshot Spit Lightvessel
rows.character: Two fixed lts., bright and red
rows.description: In 6 fathoms, near S.E. extremity of Spit. Two masts, with conical cages. One light on each mast; high light red. Bell buoy replaced when vessel needs repairs

rows.name: Netley Pier
rows.description: One fixed green light

rows.name: Hythe Pier
rows.description: Two fixed red lights, vertical

rows.name: Southampton
rows.character: 1. Two fixed red lts. 2. Two fixed green lts. 3. Two fixed lights 4. Two fixed lights
rows.description: 1. On either side of entrance to Docks. In one, N.E. by N. ½ N., lead up River Itchen in 14 ft. 2. On Extension Quay, N.W. side of R. Itchen 3. Red over bright, from lt.-vessel, at entrance of River Itchen 4. Red lt. on Royal Pier, green lt. on Town Pier
